test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What is the value of merchandise exports by India in September 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**35.45 Billion USD.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **​India’s overall exports **in April-September 2022 are estimated to be **USD 382.31 Billion.**
 
• It** **exhibits a** growth of 21.03 per cent** over the same period last year.
 
• The estimated value of services exported in **September 2022 **will be **USD 25.65 billion, **an increase of** 18.72%** from September 2021. (USD 21.61 Billion).
 
• **Compared to September 2021, when merchandise exports were at USD 33.81 billion, they increased positively by 4.82 percent to USD 35.45 billion in September 2022.**
 
• Imports of goods totalled** USD 61.16 billion in September 2022**, an increase of **USD 56.29 billion from September 2021,** or 8.66%.
 
• The **merchandise trade deficit** in **September 2022** was estimated at **USD 25.71 Billion **as against **USD 22.47 Billion** in September 2021, which is an increase of **14.42 per cent.**
